server.name: io.github.daedalusdevelopmentgroup/ddg-agent-services-mcp
server.description: Pay-per-call x402 gateway: agent tools, OpenAI-compatible LLM, market data, RPC, security audits.
server.title: DDG Agent Services

environmentVariables.description: Stable agent identifier for free-trial + usage tracking (optional).
environmentVariables.name: DDG_AGENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: EVM (Base) wallet private key used to auto-pay x402 on paid routes (optional; free/free-trial routes need no wallet).
environmentVariables.name: DDG_PRIVATE_KEY

server.name: io.github.daedalusdevelopmentgroup/ddg-agent-services-mcp
server.description: Payment-aware MCP for DDG agent services: discovery, x402 checkout, and readiness resources.

environmentVariables.description: Stable AI-agent identifier sent as X-Agent-Id to DDG public endpoints.
environmentVariables.name: DDG_MCP_AGENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: DDG service base URL. Defaults to https://agents.daedalusdevelopmentgroup.com.
environmentVariables.name: DDG_AGENT_SERVICES_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist for non-default DDG base hosts; only needed for local testing.
